named_cases.name: Default provider stays disabled with null band and no world write port
Opening/saving writing grants no upload consent; online and unlabelled fixture providers are never called
Projection sends only selected discovered externally authorized source slices and specified draft
More than six contexts and oversized full draft are refused without silent truncation
Only transient/limited replies retry, at most twice; duplicate request does not charge twice
Actual fixture-reported overrun is retained and stops new attempts; unknown metering never becomes zero billed
Timeout and user cancellation stop waiting; a late complete response is never displayed
